integrity: The source definition and example were checked in the full published text, and the earliest public arXiv record was verified separately. All defining equations were independently reconstructed from the multiplication and twist. A standalone symbolic and finite-field checker replays the classification and isolates the exact missing commutation condition.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns the one-parameter two-dimensional Hom-Jordan family in Example 2.2.
The theorem assumes characteristic different from two; characteristic two is a separate degenerate multiplication case.

The result corrects the applicability of the source's Rota-Baxter definition and Corollary 2.1; it does not assert that the displayed induced multiplication fails all Hom-pre-Jordan identities for every excluded parameter.
title: A complete repair of a two-dimensional Hom-Jordan Rota–Baxter example
